followUps.reason: Expand the reference scope: 176 more SymPy modules are extracted (the polys and matrices modules including the low-level representation modules, domains, DomainMatrix, agca and numberfields; core, assumptions, sets, logic, concrete, crypto, liealgebras, parsing and other mathematical modules; the printing and utilities modules), module-local public functions count as public API in the modules that document them, printed output (print(f(...)), pprint, print_tree, srepr, latex and other text results) becomes text cases compared as text in every module, and polynomial-ring, domain and DomainMatrix values are serialized. Every (module, src) and every API name of the previous corpus is kept. New examples that do not pass yet are listed in known-gaps.json; no previous case is among them. This is a measurement baseline expansion, not permission to accept behavior regressions.
